ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) across >95% of the visible surface; negligible macro-level high-intensity (white) distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 1/10th the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations between 3 and 15 pixels, forming a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the superior lobe margins, terminating in acute distal tips with an upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and along the ventral trailing edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notch/tissue loss on the distal margin of the right fluke lobe tip.
